body.question: The Intel 4004 was released in 1971. How many transistors did that single chip contain?
body.reveal: A single chip contained 2,300 transistors. The project began in 1969, when Busicom Corp. commissioned Intel to design a family of seven chips for electronic calculators.

probes.question: Which kind of product did Busicom commission Intel to design chips for in 1969?
True or false: the Intel 4004 was released in 1971.
